notes: The text gives two routes from «حماد»: «ثابت، عن أنس» and «أيوب، عن أبي قلابة، عن أنس»; they are written as two groups. «أنس» stands twice; occurrence 1 and 2 are the two Companions as the text writes them.
«قال أبو قلابة يعني النساء» is the transmitter's gloss on the saying and is left out.
